figurative_meaning_en: very briefly or in a very short time
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এক নিঃশ্বাসে সমস্ত কাজ শেষ করে দিল।
example_sentences_in_english: He finished all the work in one breath.
Tell the story in one breath.
note: This idiom emphasizes efficiency and speed in completing tasks without interruption.
